Session Branching is here
Branch off any message and start a new path from that exact point — everything up to then comes with you.

- Go back to a turning point and try something new
- Chase a different ending
- Rescue a session that went sideways

Branch as often as you like. Branching is free; messages still cost Credits.
Tap the branch icon under any message to start.

description:
Welcome to OOC: The Playable Anime. Dive into an immersive adventure where you don’t just read the webnovel—you step inside it. OOC is an infinite world for your imagination, creativity, and storytelling. Play, create, and share your favorite genres—all in one place.

Whether you are a fan of high-stakes Action Fantasy, the captivating drama of Romance Fantasy (RoFan), or Evergreen stories that last forever, your choices dictate the narrative. Leave the scripts behind. Your next adventure begins here!

[APP FEATURES]
■ Ad-Free Immersion: Dive deep into stories with absolutely no commercial interruptions.
■ Free Unlimited Chat: Chat endlessly for free (Only available using the Basic Model in Character Mode).
■ Shape Your Epic: Seamless character creation and world-building tools.
■ Deep Memory: Companions that truly remember your shared history and grow with you.
■ Complete Privacy Control: Keep your stories secret or publish them to the community.
■ Vibrant Community: Follow favorite creators and experience user-generated masterpieces.

[EXPLORE AN INFINITE LIBRARY OF TROPES & GENRES]
■ Action Fantasy (System, Necromancer, Regression, Hunters)
■ Romance Fantasy (Villainess, Contract Marriage, Royal Court Drama)
■ Sci-Fi & Cyberpunk
■ Slice of Life & Comedy
■ Evergreen Original Epics
■ And many more...

[NO SCRIPTS, JUST YOUR CHOICES]
Experience interactive fiction like never before. With OOC, there are no predetermined plots, and no two stories are ever the same. Every narrative is entirely unique, driven solely by your decisions, leading to unexpected plot twists. You hold the pen—craft the ultimate ending with your own hands. Simply type your actions, and watch the story unfold in real-time. You are the protagonist of your own living webtoon.

[FATEFUL ENCOUNTERS AWAIT]
Cross paths with companions intertwined by destiny. OOC features advanced characters with powerful memories. They evolve by remembering past conversations, adapting to your style, and reacting to your every word. From a ruthless emperor to a loyal knight or a mysterious mage, navigate complex character dynamics and forge unbreakable alliances. 

[UNLEASH YOUR CREATIVITY IN SECONDS]
Bring your ideas to life in seconds. Character Creation is open to everyone—no coding or professional writing skills needed. Craft alternate timelines and invent rich fictional universes. Keep your creations strictly private for your own enjoyment, or share your masterpieces with the world and build an Evergreen legacy within our global creator community.

[LIMITLESS CONVERSATIONS, ZERO INTERRUPTIONS]
Never run out of new worlds to explore. Enjoy a completely ad-free experience designed for ultimate story immersion with zero disruptive advertisements. Get lost in long, uninterrupted moments with your favorite companions. Chat endlessly for free (Only available using the Basic Model in Character Mode) without rigid restrictions. Whether you are transitioning from other chat platforms or stepping inside your favorite Webnovels, you'll find a welcoming home for immersive storytelling and pure fun.

When words come alive, when stories give you a choice, and when characters possess a soul... A new reality unfolds. 

The Story Must Go On. 

Download OOC: The Playable Anime today, meet your unforgettable allies, and let your imagination write the story of your past, present, and future. Craft your own ending. Your unwritten journey starts now!

Terms of Service: https://ooc.ai/policy/service
Privacy Policy: https://ooc.ai/policy/privacy

The app is overall good, but it has some glaring issues. The biggest is how it handles alternate regenerations. When you regenerate a response and choose which version you want to continue with, the unchosen versions aren’t actually discarded. Instead, they remain folded into the chat, and the AI can reference them in later responses as though they were part of the story you chose.

I’ve been playing for 3 weeks now. The AI model seems repeat patterns of names, phrases, and go into long tangents of extremely complex narratives to characters that do not seem to have the capacity to act that way. For context. Let’s say you run into an NPC that you the user created thats dumb as rocks. If you give them an epiphany they suddenly become a super scientist talking about spatial distortion and resonance waves. They also seem to calculate .3 second intervals of time of reaction that you can improve on. I’ve tested all paid/ free models and the results are similar across the board.
